summary.intent: Find where Caliper's semantic pipeline spends CPU (shadcn, Mantine, Chakra corpora), land the request-reduction branch, and triage the code-review findings on that branch.
summary.outcome: Found that about 40% of CPU on shadcn and Mantine is thread overhead, and that on Chakra it is real checker work cut by the request-reduction branch (perf/fewer-checker-requests). Experiment edits were reverted. Review findings were triaged, with fixes made in convert.rs and rpc.rs and committed on a local review-round branch.

repo: A cold run uses up to 18 rayon threads (one per core) plus two checker programs, each with its own checker. On shadcn, 1.96 s of 6.4 CPU-seconds is system time.

Capping rayon to 1 thread cuts shadcn CPU from 6.9 to 4.9 s for about 0.3 s more wall time. One checker program with rayon capped to 4 cuts CPU by 41% on shadcn and 23% on Mantine, and memory from 871 to 759 MiB. It is not better on Chakra, where wall time was 5.0 s vs 4.5 s.

On Chakra, 730k isReadonlySymbol requests came from workers walking the same types concurrently. The request-reduction branch cuts round trips from 61.6k to 31.6k, CPU from 12.4 to 10.45 s, and wall from 4.42 to 3.61 s.

The probe getSemanticDiagnostics call costs latency, not CPU. Skipping it cuts wall time on shadcn from 2.05 to 1.40 s and on Mantine from 1.32 to 0.91 s, with about 0.8 s less CPU. It is the largest single wall-time lever.
The JSON boundary is not a major cost.
An order-dependent bug in property_name moves a private field's checker id under --collapse-inherited-props none (seen on spectrum). It was left as a follow-up.
Chakra's fastest benchmark runs (1.55 s) were degraded runs where the checker timed out and silently fell back. Benchmark scripts should reject runs carrying a fallback warning.
The earlier gate docs chose two checker programs from idle-machine measurements.

code.finding: fields_past_size_budget is a pre-check that duplicates the size-budget cut rule in convert (around line 980), with nothing linking the two. It also re-walks the field tree at each nesting level, which is roughly quadratic in depth on hot paths such as Chakra style props.

readonly flags and cached field_types are applied with zip, which silently truncates if the cached slice and the properties list differ in length. The cache key's 'same symbols every time' invariant is not enforced.
named_bases and base_layers call .bases(..).to_vec() on a cached Arc<[TypeInfo]>, deep-cloning every base TypeInfo on each cache hit.
batch now counts inner requests under their own methods and adds an inBatches key, so summing calls() double-counts round trips. The calls doc comment was stale.

Answers keeps a OnceCell per question for the whole snapshot and never evicts, so the snapshot-wide caches grow with every distinct type handle. No peak-RSS evidence was given for the resolver change.

workflow: Run experiment binaries with env switches or overrides, then revert the edits and confirm nothing from them is committed.
On a loaded machine (load 20-40), trust CPU time and ratios over wall time, and interleave runs.
Run /code-review medium on worker branches that skipped it, then triage each finding against the actual code before fixing.
Link the branch to its trail (405) so Entire opens the PR, and publish the PR body after review.

friction: The machine was at load 20-40, so wall-time measurements were noisy.
Benchmark 'best' runs on Chakra were silently degraded fallback runs, which skewed results.
The first revert of the experiment edits failed and had to be redone by absolute path.
The new worktree needed its JS deps installed before formatting could be checked.
The review agent did not build or run tests, so its findings needed manual verification.
open_items: Decide whether to cap rayon and use one checker program by default (about 40% CPU saved, but wall time worse on Mantine and Chakra). This needs an idle-machine run first.
Prototype a cheaper way to find failed instantiations than the probe getSemanticDiagnostics call.
Review and merge PRs #505-#508, and publish the PR body for perf/fewer-checker-requests after review.
Fix the order-dependent bug in property_name that shifts a private field's checker id.
Make the weekly and comparison benchmark scripts reject runs that carry a fallback warning.
Review findings possibly not addressed in the commit: the cache memory growth in asked.rs, the Borrow generic on convert_all, and the brittle exact-count tests.
